role: District Representative · Calamba City, Lone District
profileLabel: Strongly institution-supporting; liberal-leaning on gender; mixed-to-left economics (medium confidence)
summary: Calamba City representative with 209 principal-authored bills. Authored FOI (two bills), an anti-dynasty ban, disqualification of officials' relatives from contracts and early voting for seniors and PWDs. Also authored expanded anti-discrimination protections for women and in employment, a VAT cut to 10 percent, a higher tax-exempt income threshold, a plastic-bag excise and penalties for detaining patients over unpaid bills.
caveat: Population-policy bill direction was not reviewed. The disinformation penalty bill is a single speech issue and civil liberties is unscored. Economic score mixes a VAT cut with progressive and welfare items.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored penalties for hospital detention over unpaid bills (-2); co-authored national minimum wage (-2); tax items net near zero: VAT cut to 10 percent (+2), higher exempt threshold (-1), plastic-bag excise (-1).
